The lighting is dim, creating strong shadows and reflections on the glossy surfaces.

The elliptical shape of the driver seems slightly inconsistent with the box's perspective, suggesting minor geometric warping or alignment issues.

The object in the bottom left (possibly an amplifier or receiver) has ill-defined boundaries. The cables appear to merge into the device casing without clear ports, and the overall shape lacks rigid structural definition, appearing somewhat 'mushy' or melted.
